components.label: protocol
responsibilities: Decode one request and encode one response using the shared codec.
forbidden_responsibilities: Filesystem discovery, syntax parsing and policy.

requires.rationale: protocol consumes the typed output of collection.

components.label: collection
responsibilities: Assemble source evidence and coverage into SourceFacts; never evaluate architecture policy.
forbidden_responsibilities: Parser nodes, direct filesystem reads and rule verdicts.

requires.rationale: collection consumes the typed output of snapshot.
collection consumes the typed output of syntax.
collection consumes the typed output of resolution.

components.label: snapshot
responsibilities: Read bounded immutable source bytes and package metadata; reject escapes and record exact input digests.
forbidden_responsibilities: AST interpretation, symbol resolution and reading outside the snapshot.

components.label: syntax
responsibilities: Own Tree-sitter nodes and extract immutable Dart syntax values with precise spans and gaps.
forbidden_responsibilities: Filesystem reads, process execution, target contracts and inferred compiler semantics.

components.label: resolution
responsibilities: Bind libraries, parts and source-level names only when unique and supported by selected inputs.
forbidden_responsibilities: Filesystem reads, parser nodes, runtime dispatch and policy.

requires.rationale: resolution consumes the typed output of snapshot.
resolution consumes the typed output of syntax.
